$comment: v6.3 D12a minimal rule and obligation registry. Rules: kind legacy may carry outcome_contract 'pending' (evaluated as unverified); kind new or changed needs reason codes for all five states. V cases: per slice part, status not-run | expected-failure | required-before-enforcement | passing; expected-failure and passing name the tests that run them. Impact groups map changed paths to test modules or run_all_checks parts; a not-available check, an unmatched path or a full group forces the full closure. Registry 1.1.0 (cross-artifact check architecture, Phase 0): every new or changed rule records source_sha256, the function-level source digest of its implementation; rule_registry.py check fails when the code changes without a new version (P3). Slices P0-P2 and work packages P<phase>.<nn> / WP-R name the architecture's phases. Registry 1.2.0 (release R2): a rule is keyed by (rule_id, version); a fixed rule is a new entry (kind changed) beside its old version, which stays listed with lifecycle retired, needs no implementation and is not digest-checked.
